mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.name, w.slug, w.created_at, w.updated_at FROM workspace w JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.workspace_id = w.id WHERE wm.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY w.id
SELECT id, name, slug, created_at, updated_at FROM workspace WHERE slug = 'default' LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.email, u.password_hash, u.timezone, u.last_login_at, u.profile_picture_url, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM app_user u JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.user_id = u.id WHERE wm.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY u.display_name, u.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_member (workspace_id, user_id, role) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{role})
